task_snapshot.objective: Transform the supplied fixture into validated JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Every input record appears exactly once.
stop_conditions: Stop if the input cannot be parsed.

rationale: The task is specific, repeatable, and has a deterministic output.
quality_gate: Every input record appears exactly once in valid JSON.
escalate_when: Acceptance fails after at most one useful targeted correction; missing source evidence stops escalation.

allowed: Read the supplied fixture and return transformed JSON.
prohibited: Edit source files or contact external services.
proof_required: Report input and output record counts.
stop_conditions: Stop if the input cannot be parsed.
